what: the 12 headline pools the hierarchical attacker runs on (RUN_DECISIONS D8)
method: the 46 headline pool ids ordered by sha256('hier-subset|' + pool_id); first 12. Chosen by id hash only: no fragment, text, score or outcome was read.
rule_D11: FROZEN before any headline result. The hierarchical attacker runs on (a) every headline pool where one-shot J exhausts the 128k ceiling (a resource-bounded non-completion, D6), then (b) the first pools of fill_order not already in (a), until 12. Two analyses, never combined: (1) RBNC rescue on (a); (2) paired attacker comparison on (b) only. The 12 are failure-enriched and never averaged into a headline mean.
